caption: The drawing depicts a circular design centered within a teal-blue square. At the center of the circle is a raised, button-like form with concentric rings colored in green, gold, and red. Radiating from the center are six red triangular segments that resemble spokes or star points, each outlined in gold and stretching to the circumference of the circle. Between these red spokes are six curved gold bands, forming wave-like arches. The edge of the circle is bordered by concentric rings in green, gold, and red. Scattered within the spaces between the spokes and against the teal-blue background are small gold star-like shapes. The outer area surrounding the central square is a plain, light tan color.
title: Zoar Ceiling Ornament
